def priority(f):
    d = f["distance"]
    r = f["return_distance"]
    nr = f["nearest_remaining"]
    mr = f["mean_remaining"]
    g = f["regret"]
    p = f["progress"]
    cd = f["cluster_density"]
    inv_mr = 1.0 / max(mr, 1e-9)
    isolation = 1.0 - nr * inv_mr
    return -d + (0.15 + 0.45 * p) * r + (0.35 - 0.15 * p) * g + 0.05 * (1 - p) * cd + 0.10 * (1 - p) * isolation
